sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.
Stops usage events, crash reports and performance data from reaching Perplexity, Singular and Firebase.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Hides the subscription offer after signing in, the Upgrade plan banner, home screen promotions and upgrade cards in answers. Plan limits still apply.
